name: Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery
summary: Formulating and stress-testing operational continuity plans for power grid failures, floods, cyber hacks, and civil unrest.
benefits: Business Impact Analysis (BIA) defining Recovery Time Objectives (RTO)
Alternative site disaster recovery protocols and supply chain redundancy matrices
Crisis simulation exercises and staff emergency readiness drills
Guarantees rapid restoration of mission-critical business functions
Protects customer confidence and contracts during unforeseen macro disruptions
eligibility: Process dependency data and IT infrastructure topology
audience: Financial institutions, utilities, mission-critical processors, and retailers
